predictions.rationale: Primary class that defines the UML Activity Diagram type used in ArgoUML; directly represents and manages activity diagrams.
Factory responsible for creating Activity Diagram instances in the newer activity2 module, fundamental to the feature.
Defines the underlying graph model (nodes/edges) for Activity Diagrams, essential for their behavior representation.
Renders Activity Diagram elements on screen; closely tied to visualizing workflow sequences and activity states.
Handles automatic layout of Activity Diagram elements, directly supporting the diagram’s visual organization.
Creates property panels specific to Activity Diagrams, enabling users to edit activity-related model properties.
Module class that registers and initializes the Activity Diagram functionality within the application.
Provides actions to add elements into Activity Diagrams, directly supporting diagram editing and construction.
Base figure class for nodes within Activity Diagrams; fundamental for displaying activities/states visually.
UI component that lists/selects Activity Graph contexts; supports editing of Activity Diagram–related model elements.
